work_or_witness: Road to Legend · Into the Dungeon
definition: In traditional Descent, up to four players take hero roles while one overlord player commands monsters and forces of evil against them.
cultural_caution: These are game roles, not evidence that any selectable hero, monster, or overlord card is a fixed named dramatic person. No role is promoted to a character node in this audit.

supports: Fantasy Flight Games describes the traditional hero-player and single-overlord-player roles.

work_or_witness: Road to Legend · Product description, lines 69–70
definition: Second Edition is described as a two-to-five-player board game in which adventurers undertake a campaign of linked quests while developing characters based on four fantasy archetypes.
cultural_caution: A campaign linkage is a play-system statement, not a claim that every branch, character build, or table outcome belongs to one fixed story continuity. Quest plots and outcomes are kept outside this terms-only pass.

supports: Fantasy Flight Games describes Second Edition as a campaign of linked quests with character development based on four fantasy archetypes.

work_or_witness: Road to Legend introduction and product description
definition: The fantasy realm in which the official product description places Second Edition's dungeon adventures and linked-quest campaign.
cultural_caution: A setting term only. Terrinoth is not a character, a monolithic culture, or proof that all games using related setting material share the selected Second Edition core continuity.

citations.locator: Road to Legend introduction and product description
supports: Fantasy Flight Games places Descent's heroes and linked-quest adventures in Terrinoth.

work_or_witness: Road to Legend · Into the Dungeon; Grow Your Collection; Runes, Heroes, and Legends · 2012 – Descent: Journeys in the Dark Second Edition
definition: A later companion app for Descent that takes the traditional overlord role, controls figures and related game responsibilities, and lets the player group cooperate as heroes.
cultural_caution: A separate app/product-mode boundary. Its app-managed quest order, map revelation, monsters, campaigns, purchased skills, owned expansions, and outcomes are not silently substituted for traditional Second Edition core rules or narrative facts.

citations.locator: Into the Dungeon; Grow Your Collection
supports: Fantasy Flight Games identifies Road to Legend as a companion app that assumes the overlord role, supports cooperative play, requires a core set, and can draw on physical expansions.

citations.locator: 2012 – Descent: Journeys in the Dark Second Edition
supports: Fantasy Flight Games identifies Road to Legend as the Second Edition companion app and distinguishes the much later Descent: Legends of the Dark.
